senses.gloss: m. pl.(b. h. בְּלוֹאִים, בְּלוֹיי׳ , v. בְּלָאוֹת) fragments, rags.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 15b">Succ. 15ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>בְּלָאֵי כלים</he> torn pieces of garments.
<cite ref="Chullin 107b">Ḥull. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>בלאי חמתות</he> fragments of wine bags.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:5">Kel. XXVII, 5</cite> <he>בְּלוֹיֵי נפה וכ׳</he> (leather) pieces from a winnow or sieve.
